name: Wdash Admin Dashboard Style
author: amirhoseinrashidi

sections.description:
Wdash Admin Dashboard Style allows you to easily change the appearance of your WordPress dashboard to match your personal taste. With Wdash, managing your website becomes more enjoyable and visually appealing.
Stay tuned for exciting new features and updates every month!

Features

  • Sidebar Color Customization: Choose from multiple attractive colors for the admin sidebar.
  • Menu Items Styling: Customize the text and background colors of main admin menu items.
  • Submenu Styling: Change the background and text colors of submenu items.
  • Settings Persistence: Your selected colors are saved and remain active on future visits.
  • User-Friendly Interface: No coding skills required.
  • Lightweight & Optimized: Minimal impact on website performance.
  • Regular Updates: New features and improvements delivered monthly.

Usage

After activation, a new menu item called “Wdash” will appear in your WordPress dashboard. Click on it to access the plugin settings page.

From there, you can:
* Choose your desired sidebar color.
* Customize the colors for main menu items.
* Customize the colors for submenu items.

Your settings will be saved automatically and applied on each visit to the admin dashboard.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect any user data.

Feedback & Contributions

We always welcome your suggestions and contributions to improve Wdash. Please feel free to reach out via our website.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP file of the “Wdash Admin Dashboard Style” plugin via your WordPress admin panel (Plugins → Add New).
  2. After uploading, activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Will Wdash slow down my website?

No, Wdash is designed to be lightweight and optimized for performance.

Do I need coding skills to use Wdash?

Not at all! Wdash comes with a simple and user-friendly interface.

How often is Wdash updated?

We aim to release new features and improvements every month. Make sure to keep the plugin up to date.

What should I do if I encounter an issue?

You can contact us through our website (www.dilelectronic.ir) and we’ll be happy to help.
